_note: Annotated version of household_model.json. The GSSK kernel ignores all fields prefixed with '_'. Edit household_model.json for simulation; use this file for documentation and onboarding.

metadata.name: Household Ecological-Economy
metadata.description: Multi-carrier household model demonstrating money, energy, material and information flows. Reference example for Phase 5 — all five edge logic types, quality accounting (emergy), and cross-carrier coupling.
metadata.author: GSSK reference examples

carriers._note: Money: physically conserved within the household boundary (salary in, tax+spending out). AUD chosen as the unit — scale k values accordingly.
Energy: conserved by the first law. Includes electrical (kWh), chemical (fuel), and metabolic energy. Source quality_input=1.0 enables emergy tracing.
Material: mass-conserved within the household boundary. Waste leaves to landfill; food enters from market and water supply.
Information: NOT conserved (conserved:false). Attention and decisions are cognitively bounded and decay — the household forgets or ignores most incoming news.

nodes._note: Money source. 'value:1.0' is a normalised source strength; actual flow is set by edge k=5000. quality_input:1.0 seeds emergy propagation through the money carrier.
Primary liquid savings. Starts at 5000 AUD. This node is the hub of cross-carrier coupling — it controls grocery purchasing (interaction edge).
Superannuation (retirement savings). Grows at a fixed 550 AUD/month (super_contrib edge). Not connected to spending — isolated from the household budget.
Credit card liability. Starts at zero. When balance exceeds 500 AUD the threshold edge (credit_payment) triggers a minimum repayment of 300 AUD/month.
Catch-all money sink for mortgage, tax, and discretionary spending. Named 'tax' for brevity but aggregates all outbound money flows in this simplified model.
Solar irradiance. Normalised source; quality_input:1.0 starts the emergy chain for the energy carrier. Edge k=80 represents a nominal 8 kWh/day rooftop array.
Lithium battery. Starts partially charged at 5 kWh. Receives solar charge (linear k=80), exports excess to grid (linear k=0.05), loses to self-discharge (linear k=0.01).
Accumulated feed-in tariff credit (kWh exported to grid). Grows as excess solar is exported. Not currently monetised back to bank_account in this model.
Vehicle fuel tank. 40 kWh ≈ ~4 L petrol equivalent. Burns at k=0.03/month (vehicle_burn edge). No refuelling edge in this model — a deliberate simplification.
Metabolic energy reserve (glycogen + adipose). 350 kWh ≈ 42 kg fat. Gains energy from food via fridge_eat (limit logic); loses via body_metabolism (linear).
Irreversible thermodynamic sink. All entropy-generating flows terminate here: battery self-discharge, metabolic heat, vehicle combustion.
Idealised grocery market — essentially infinite supply. Normalised to 1.0. Real flow rate is determined by the exchange node (grocery_exchange) jointly by goods availability and bank_account.

EXCHANGE node (schema v4) — atomic grocery transaction. Goods flow in from grocery_market; money flows in from bank_account. F_goods = k × Q_market × Q_bank; F_money = price × F_goods. price=100 gives 0.1 × Q_bank AUD/month outflow.
Municipal water supply. Constant 1.5 kg/month into pantry (water_fill edge). Treated as unlimited in this model.
Dry goods and non-perishables. Receives grocery deliveries and water. Transfers to fridge (linear), spoils into waste_bin (linear k=0.03).
Refrigerated food. Fills from pantry. Consumed by body_energy via limit logic (saturation at ~3 kg threshold). Spoils at k=0.02/month.
Clothing and textiles. Wears out at k=0.01/month into waste_bin. No purchasing edge — clothing is not resupplied in this simplified model.
Household durables (appliances, furniture). Depreciates at k=0.005/month into waste_bin. A very slow linear drain representing appliance end-of-life.
Intermediate waste accumulator. Receives spoilage, wear, and appliance depreciation. Empties at k=0.5/month to waste_landfill (simulating weekly bin collection).
Final material sink. Represents landfill. All waste ultimately ends here. Monitoring this node gives total household waste output.
Incoming news and information. Normalised source. Controls the rate at which household_attention converts to pending_decisions via an interaction edge.
Cognitive bandwidth — the household's capacity to process information. Starts at 100 decisions/month. Replenished by news at constant k=10; decays at k=0.05/month.
Decision queue. Backlog of pending choices (budget, shopping, maintenance). Filled by attention×news interaction (k=0.02). Resolved/forgotten at k=0.3/month.
Decisions that were never acted on (forgotten or overtaken by events). Receives from both pending_decisions (resolved/forgotten at k=0.3) and attention_decay (k=0.05).

edges._note: CONSTANT — fixed salary of 5000 AUD/month. F = k regardless of account balance. This is the primary energy source for the money carrier.
CONSTANT — mandatory superannuation contribution (11% of gross ≈ 550 AUD/month). Bypasses the spending/banking loop entirely.
CONSTANT — mortgage repayment of 1800 AUD/month. Fixed obligation, does not vary with account balance.
CONSTANT — income tax and rates of 600 AUD/month. Fixed government obligation.

THRESHOLD — credit card minimum repayment. F = 300 AUD/month only when Q_credit > 500 AUD. The kernel's Illinois event detector locates the exact crossing time. Currently always 0 since debt starts at 0 and no credit-spending edge exists.
LINEAR — solar panel charging. F = 80 × Q_sunlight = 80 kWh/month (≈ 2.7 kWh/day from a 3 kW array with ~30% capacity factor). The battery grows rapidly in early months.
LINEAR — export of excess battery charge to grid. F = 0.05 × Q_battery. At Q=5 kWh that's 0.25 kWh/month — slow export. Grid credit accumulates over years.
LINEAR — battery self-discharge. F = 0.01 × Q_battery. Lithium batteries lose ~1%/month to internal resistance. Irreversible — goes to heat_loss.
LINEAR — basal metabolic rate. F = 0.02 × Q_body ≈ 7 kWh/month at rest. Energy dissipated as body heat. The body must eat to maintain Q_body_energy.
LINEAR — vehicle fuel consumption. F = 0.03 × Q_fuel. At 40 kWh initial charge = 1.2 kWh/month (negligible driving). Increases if vehicle_fuel is refilled.
Goods flow in: grocery_market supplies the exchange node.
Money flow in: bank_account funds the purchase.
Goods flow out: pantry receives the groceries.
Money flow out: payment leaves household (external sink).
CONSTANT — mains water input to pantry. 1.5 kg/month (cooking, drinking water stored before use). Independent of financial state.
LINEAR — pantry to fridge transfer. F = 0.2 × Q_pantry. Perishables moved from pantry into refrigerated storage at 20%/month rate.

LIMIT — food consumption (Michaelis-Menten). F = 2 × Q_fridge / (1 + Q_fridge/3). Maximum eating rate is k=2 kg/month; half-saturation at C=threshold=3 kg. Physical constraint: stomach capacity limits intake rate regardless of fridge contents.
LINEAR — pantry spoilage. F = 0.03 × Q_pantry. Dry goods spoil slowly (3%/month). Increases with pantry load.
LINEAR — fridge spoilage. F = 0.02 × Q_fridge. Refrigerated food spoils at 2%/month (slower than pantry). Represents forgotten leftovers.
LINEAR — bin collection. F = 0.5 × Q_waste_bin. Weekly bin collection represented as 50%/month drain from the waste accumulator to landfill.
LINEAR — appliance depreciation. F = 0.005 × Q_appliances. 0.5%/month wear — a $2000 appliance contributes $10/month in waste mass. Very slow drain.
LINEAR — clothing wear. F = 0.01 × Q_wardrobe. 1%/month attrition — a 50 kg wardrobe loses 0.5 kg/month to rags, disposal.
CONSTANT — attention replenishment from news. F = 10 decisions/month regardless of existing attention level. News is always available; whether it is absorbed depends on the interaction edge.

INTERACTION — news-driven decision generation. F = 0.02 × Q_attention × Q_news. Decisions emerge from the product of cognitive bandwidth and news volume. Cross-carrier analogy: attention is the 'money' controlling information flow.
LINEAR — decision resolution. F = 0.3 × Q_pending. 30%/month of pending decisions get resolved or abandoned. High k means the household is decisive.
LINEAR — attention decay. F = 0.05 × Q_attention. Cognitive bandwidth erodes without rest and renewal — 5%/month background decay (distraction, fatigue).

config._note: 24 months at dt=0.1 month. RK4 solver. At this dt the Michaelis-Menten limit edge linearisation error is < 0.1% (see docs/LIMIT_LOGIC.md).
